name: Novotel Panama City

name: Sofitel Legend Casco Viejo - Panama City
desc: Sofitel Legend Casco Viejo, Panama City is the only luxury oceanfront hotel in the old quarter. Set in the 1917 former Union Club, our 5 star hotel sits on the waterfront in the historic district. Business and leisure guests alike will enjoy our spacious Pacific-facing pool deck, sophisticated brasserie and vibrant rooftop bar.
